citation_counting_rule: Citation appearances count one single [n] or one range [n]–[m] as one; separate [n], [m] count two. Includes all body/table captions, cells and notes; excludes bibliography.

source_restrictions.S18: Zhang, Yao, Zhao, Wei (2025), Mechanical Sciences 16, 821–830, 10.5194/ms-16-821-2025; vacuum-confined PVC layer-jamming theoretical/mechanistic analogue only. No positive-pressure fiber/TiNi/MP1-R validation.
source_restrictions.S15: Secondary laminar-review orientation only; excludes fiber and granular coverage. Not independent mechanics replication.
source_restrictions.S17: Metric-definition/context only; no primary mechanics support.
source_restrictions.S05: Two distinct published works, Part I and Part II, retain separate IEEE numbers under one canonical source family.
source_restrictions.S07: Transformation-aware FE with simplified/frictionless contact; not independent friction calibration.
source_restrictions.S12: Physical steel-rope experiments versus numerical SMA results; do not describe SMA as independently experimentally validated.
source_restrictions.V-W02: Formally published cable paper; numerical axial/transformation/contact role, not MP1-R experimental validation. No invented internal-artifact citation.
source_restrictions.S22: Selected internal cable-layer resistance measured; normal load/average pressure inferred using borrowed friction and approximate area; no joint wire–wire/wire–sleeve partition.
source_restrictions.S04: Dedicated wire–rubber sliding-resistance and SMA-friction precedent; resistance does not separately establish μ and N; actuator thermal state is distinct from structural TiNi.
source_restrictions.all_sources: Evidence remains architecture/domain scoped; original publication controls source facts; canonical Phase 4/5 controls transfer and contribution wording.

evidence_strength_restrictions: Use RP001–RP010 and E01–E05 only within their stated architecture/material/metric boundaries.
Treat RP011–RP016 as supported connections/analogue-only where marked.
Treat RP017–RP020 as unresolved; do not use them as established mechanisms.
S15 remains contextual review support; S18 identity/restrictions remain corrected; S19/S20/S21 have no scientific support role.
prohibited_claims: First positive-pressure variable-stiffness structure or first positive-pressure fiber-jamming principle/model.
First SMA/friction mechanism or first SMA-controlled friction modulation of wire-based structures.
First NiTi wire-jamming system or first wire/fiber jamming system.
Fluid pressure directly equals every inter-wire or wire–sleeve normal force.
Global bending proves wire–wire jamming or identifies interface dominance.
NiTi transformation necessarily dominates MP1-R hysteresis.
NiTi identity alone proves active transformation in the accessible bending domain.
Conventional models are insufficient, definitively falsified, or rejected because one simplification fails.
A new constitutive pressure–contact–material coupling law is required.
Interface disambiguation is already a demonstrated literature-wide scientific knowledge gap.
No relevant prior work combines any of the MP1-R mechanisms.
S18 proves positive-pressure fiber jamming or is a direct S03 precursor.
S19, S20 or S21 supplies scientific mechanics evidence; S20's retired identity may not be restored.
SMA spring-to-fluid displacement is novel solely because the drive or geometry differs.
Universal SMA cooling/response time inferred from S04.
Integrated response differences at unmatched pressure, temperature or history prove H1.
Different geometry, material, pressure levels, more FEA/measurements or held-out testing alone establish novelty.
A global loop, DMA loss tangent or F–δ slope directly equals M–κ bending work or local friction loss.
A source pressure gauge alone establishes specimen pressure or contact force.
No previous research has studied this mechanism.
The unresolved pressure/contact map is itself a demonstrated scientific knowledge gap.
The project contribution requires H1-R to be supported.
A null pressure effect or successful H0b result makes the thesis scientifically invalid.
The current working title can be used as causal evidence that pressure-controlled friction has already been demonstrated in MP1-R.

gap_boundary.wording: Unestablished in the validated corpus / project-specific characterization or identification; no literature-wide absence or first-ever claim.

primary_contribution: Quantitative pressure-conditioned bending characterization of the defined TiNi-bundle configuration, with a locked conventional model-discrimination baseline.
secondary_contributions: Interface/local-slip system identification when independent constraints are available.
Predictive discrimination of existing conventional mechanics on reserved paths.

primary_research_question.question: For a fixed TiNi-bundle geometry, material lot and loading history, how does controlled near-specimen pressure change the bending response, and how accurately does a locked conventional contact/friction/transformation-aware model predict reserved pressure–curvature paths?

secondary_research_questions.question: Which pressure-conditioned resistance pathway—wire–wire, wire–sleeve, or sleeve/end motion—can be identified or bounded using independent interface and local-slip observations?
Does the same-lot TiNi undergo transformation in the accessed strain/temperature/history domain, and what material-state control is required to interpret the measured response?

experimental_engineering_objectives.objective: Fix and document the cross-section, reaction surfaces, interface candidates, packing, sleeve and boundary conditions before interpreting pressure effects.
Measure repeatable pressure-conditioned bending response with near-specimen pressure, calibrated force/moment/curvature, temperature and loading-history controls.
Establish same-lot material and interface/local-slip controls sufficient to distinguish material state, friction and boundary alternatives to the extent feasible.
Lock, calibrate and test a conventional baseline on reserved pressure–curvature paths with uncertainty-aware comparison.
Characterize the SMA-spring/piston pressure–volume envelope and compare integrated and external-source responses under matched conditions.

optional_scientific_extensions.extension: Evaluate an additional state-conditioned pressure/contact/material term only after H0a/H0b and confounders are bounded.
optional_scientific_extensions.condition: Repeatable held-out residual plus identifiable predictive improvement.

optional_scientific_extensions.extension: Attempt fuller transformation/friction/sleeve loss partition beyond aggregate loop work.
optional_scientific_extensions.condition: Independent local, material and interface observations are available.

causal_chain_status.link: radial reaction → local contact normal forces
local contact normal forces → friction capacity

approved_chapter2_gap_wording.safe_strongest_wording: The validated literature establishes pressure-dependent response in related architectures, but does not establish the pressure-to-local-contact transmission for the defined TiNi-bundle configuration.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.more_conservative_wording: The pressure-to-contact relation remains unestablished for this configuration and must be bounded experimentally.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.prohibited_wording: No previous research has studied pressure-to-contact transmission.

approved_chapter2_gap_wording.safe_strongest_wording: Interface-specific resistance tests provide precedents, while pressure-conditioned wire–wire versus wire–sleeve contribution remains a system-identification question for MP1-R.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.more_conservative_wording: The dominant interface cannot be inferred from global bending alone.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.prohibited_wording: Interface disambiguation is a literature-wide scientific gap.

approved_chapter2_gap_wording.safe_strongest_wording: NiTi state-sensitive response is established in tested domains, but transformation activity in the accessed same-lot bending domain is not established.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.more_conservative_wording: The study will characterize whether transformation is active in the measured domain.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.prohibited_wording: TiNi necessarily transforms and dominates hysteresis.

approved_chapter2_gap_wording.safe_strongest_wording: Existing conventional formulations provide a comparator, but their predictive adequacy for the defined MP1-R configuration has not been quantitatively tested on reserved paths.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.more_conservative_wording: A locked conventional baseline is required before any stronger coupling claim.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.prohibited_wording: The literature lacks the exact equation, so a new law is required.

approved_chapter2_gap_wording.safe_strongest_wording: The proposed source operating envelope and matched integrated/external response remain to be validated for the selected architecture.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.more_conservative_wording: Actuator and integration performance are supporting validation tasks.
approved_chapter2_gap_wording.prohibited_wording: A different spring/piston arrangement is automatically a new scientific mechanism.

recommended_phase7_audit_targets: Check every substantive claim against its actual source and preserve architecture/domain restrictions, not merely the presence of a citation.
Verify S05 two-work bibliography, S11 missing volume/issue and V-W02 online-versus-print version without inventing metadata.
Verify S18 vacuum PVC analogue, S15 laminar-review scope and S17 metric-context-only use.
Verify S12 physical steel versus numerical SMA; V-W02 numerical axial scope; S04/S22 resistance versus independently known μ/N.
Check metric dimensions, Coulomb bound assumptions and work-per-length versus total work/local dissipation.
Check that global bending does not identify a dominant interface and that same-lot TiNi identity does not prove active transformation.
Check PRQ01/SRQ01/SRQ02 and characterization/model discrimination boundary; ensure no claim requires H1.
Check citations in editable table cells/notes as well as prose; first-appearance numbering and bibliography identities.
Audit each clause of paragraph/row-level trace entries; RP evidence labels are canonical support/boundaries, not automatic proof of every clause.
